hero.title: Proud Achievements
hero.description: Various government awards and honors received by the Gram Panchayat in recognition of its work and contribution to village development.
hero.caption: Recognition for village development and public service

section.title: Government Awards and Honors
section.description: The following awards recognize the Gram Panchayat's work in cleanliness, digital services, community harmony, administrative quality, and environmental conservation.

awards.title: Sant Gadge Baba Village Cleanliness Award
awards.description: First place at the district level for excellent village cleanliness and wastewater management. The entire village was declared Open Defecation Free (ODF Plus).

awards.title: Smart Village Award
awards.description: Recognized by the government for the effective implementation of digital facilities, Wi-Fi, and the e-Gram Panchayat system in the village.

awards.title: Mahatma Gandhi Dispute-Free Village Award
awards.description: Special recognition from the State Government for resolving all village disputes amicably and maintaining peace and order in the village.

awards.title: ISO 9001:2015 Certification
awards.description: Received an international-standard ISO certificate for maintaining transparency and quality in the Gram Panchayat's office administration.

awards.title: Yashwantrao Chavan Village Prosperity Award
awards.description: Recognized at the taluka level for notable achievements in water conservation and tree plantation programmes.

footer.message: Honors that reflect our commitment to village development, quality public service, and community progress.
